reasoning_steps: Z09 fixes Resident_D in House1; A,B,C,E occupy Houses2-5.
Z14 with S06: House1's neighbor bearing Color_E must be House2, so Color_E=House2.
Z05 requires Color_C immediately left of Color_B; since House2=Color_E the only viable placements are (C=H3,B=H4) [Case i] or (C=H4,B=H5) [Case ii].
Z01 places Resident_A in the Color_A house; House1 is Resident_D, so Color_A cannot be House1, forcing Color_A into the remaining slot and Resident_A there; Color_D falls on House1.

In Case (i) Color_A=H5, Color_D=H1; deriving drinks (Z03,Z08,Z04) and brands (Z07,Z12,Z13) leaves Brand_A only on houses holding Pet_D or Pet_A, contradicting Z06 (Brand_A owner keeps Pet_B). Case (i) fails to close by hand.

In Case (ii): Color_A=H3 (Resident_A), Color_D=H1. Z03 gives Drink_A=H5, Z08 gives Drink_C=H3; Z04 places Resident_C at House2 with Drink_B; Z12 with Z07 forces Drink_D=House4 and Brand_D there, so Resident_E (Brand_E, Z13) takes House5 and Resident_B House4.
Z02 puts Pet_A at House4; Z11 puts Pet_D at House2; Z06 forces Brand_A at House3 with Pet_B; Z10 places Pet_C at House1; the only remaining pet slot House5 receives Zebra.
This complete arrangement satisfies every active clue when hand-checked, yielding Zebra to Resident_E in House5.
No model-checker/SHACL tool was supplied, so this is an abductive hand-verified consistency argument, not a formal entailment; Case (i) was only informally rejected.
unstated_assumptions: The by-hand elimination of Case (i) via the Z06/Pet_B conflict is exhaustive; a missed branch could reopen it.
Each derivation step used standard uniqueness (S03/S04) so that a pet/drink/brand appears exactly once per house across all houses.
No formal reasoner confirmed uniqueness; other conforming arrangements could in principle assign Zebra elsewhere.
Treated all unstated assignments as unknown (S08) rather than false.
most_useful_missing_information: A formal OWL/model-checker or SHACL result confirming whether Case (i) is truly inconsistent and whether the Case (ii) arrangement is the unique solution (i.e., whether Zebra ownership is entailed).
